faqs.q: Sec. 30-70. - Special requirements for second recall.
faqs.a:
After one recall petition and election, no further petition shall be filed against
               the same officer during the term for which he was elected unless the petitioners signing
               said petition equal 50 percent of all ballots cast for that office at the last preceding
               general municipal election.
(Code 1981, § 11-41; Ord. No. 3511, § 2, 2-1-1999)
